content:
name: Governed execution C2 Codex live activation

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "crates/monad-codex-live-activation/**"
      - "crates/monad-codex-confinement/**"
      - "crates/monad-codex-runtime/**"
      - "testing/governed-execution-c2-codex-live-activation.md"
      - ".github/workflows/governed-execution-c2-codex-live-activation.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  activation-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
      - name: Validate locked workspace graph
        run: cargo metadata --locked --no-deps > /dev/null
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check
      - name: Test live activation binding
        run: cargo test --locked -p monad-codex-live-activation
      - name: Regress confinement certification
        run: cargo test --locked -p monad-codex-confinement
      - name: Regress Codex runtime
        run: cargo test --locked -p monad-codex-runtime

metadata.title: Governed Execution C2 Codex Live Activation
